title: Fun and underrated experience!
text: Had a great time and learned so much about olives. The olive oil tasted great, even with the ice cream. Highly recommend!
author: 378faheemr

title: So Much To Learn About Olive Oil - Seville
text: Isaac, the owner and GM of the Basilippo OO estate was a super host.  Friendly, patient, and informative about the different types of olives (>300), how they're grown, harvested and processed. Knowing that he gives this tour probably close to 700X per year (just a guess), he made us feel like we were the only ones he ever talked to. Luis our driver was very friendly and did a great job too.  A good team!  We bought lots of primo OO from Basilippo.
author: Cary V

title: Basilippo Olive Farm
text: I highly recommend this tour if you are visiting Seville. Alfonzo from Seville Moving was very informative and went above and beyond stopping at an extra stop to show us an old castle. Basilippo olive farm and the owner Isaac was amazing.
author: 852chloen

title: Very interesting
text:
It was a very interesting and informative tour. We get to see different methods and taste different oils.

Our driver was Mr. Javi he's very nice man and very helpful, he also speaks good English.

He also took us to a small village on the way as we were a bit early.

It was a nice time spent, will definitely recommend it
author: ShadenA37

author: Yamile_R

title: Just Book It!
text: Simply amazing! I highly recommend  this tour! Isaac and his family are absolutely wonderful.  Our driver was so knowledgable as well. He knew so much history in Sevilla as we were driving to the olive oil farm. From the moment we were picked up to the end of the tour, we felt so special.  Their attentiveness to us was incredible.  The family who owns the olive oil farm is very welcoming and passionate about their work.  You can't help but enjoy their company and respect this beautiful place.
